question: What status is attributed to Kāma-deva in this description such that freedom from age marks him as a second form?
premises: Kāma-deva is described as freed from wrinkles and grey hair.
The two descriptors qualify the same subject.
inference: Kāma-deva, freed from wrinkles and grey hair, appears here as the second of his kind.
